title: TelemetrySpansRow
description: One span in the canonical spans table over the full available span (03 §2.4). Written by Infralume, which applies the span error-status rule (01 §3.5).

trace_id.description: Trace id as a string (leading zeros kept; lowercase hex for OTLP sources).

span_id.description: Span id as a string (leading zeros kept; lowercase hex for OTLP sources).

parent_span_id.description: Parent span id; null for a root span, never the empty string. An unknown parent is kept as given.

component.description: Normalised component (e.g. pod) name; null or the service when unknown, as Infralume decides.

operation.description: Operation name (methodName if non-empty, else operationName; OTLP span name).

kind.description: Span kind; unspecified when the source has none.

start_ns.description: Span start in ns since the Unix epoch (UTC), source time as given.

end_ns.description: Span end in ns; spans with end_ns < start_ns are dropped at ingest.

status.description: Span status from the error-status rule (01 §3.5); the native OTel status wins for OTLP sources.

status_code.description: HTTP or gRPC status code (or OTel status code under rule 1 of 01 §3.5); null when absent or NaN.

attrs_json.description: Canonical JSON of span attributes, scrubbed.
